# CMU-REvised Docs

> How to update, prepare and mod a Mazda Connect (CMU150) head unit with the Revised Store. The Store needs firmware 74.00.324A. The unit's screen runs Opera 12 (Presto, 2012): mods use ES5 JavaScript and old CSS only.

## Guides

- [Update to 74.00.324A](https://docs.cmu-revised.com/guides/update-firmware): bring the unit to the firmware the Store is built for
- [Prepare a USB stick](https://docs.cmu-revised.com/guides/usb-stick): format a stick the way the car reads it
- [Install the Store](https://docs.cmu-revised.com/guides/install-store): one-time install from a USB stick, then online through a phone hotspot
- [Link your car](https://docs.cmu-revised.com/guides/link-car): connect the car to an account

## Make mods

- [Build with an AI agent](https://docs.cmu-revised.com/guides/build-with-ai): what to give a coding agent and what it must never do on a real car
- [revised-sdk AGENTS.md](https://github.com/eXXon48/revised-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): setup, package format, testing and hard rules for coding agents

## Optional

- [revised-sdk guide](https://github.com/eXXon48/revised-sdk/blob/main/docs/guide.md): lint rules, the RevisedHMI API and every CLI command
- [Store apps](https://cmu-revised.com/apps): the published package list
